Subject: Internal: CloudVista redline guidance + fallback positions

Team —

Quick internal note before legal drafts:
- Pricing: Elena’s 30% uplift should map into Exhibit B as an additional SKU line with burst bucket pricing (propose 1.5x base token price for burst tokens).
- Term: accept 18 months starting 2026-12-01; include an option to renew at the then-current rate with 60 days’ notice.
- Data retention: procurement asks for reduced audit log retention to 90 days. Our standard is 365. Propose compromise: 180 days for non-sensitive audit logs; 365 for security/audit logs.
- Credits: Elena asked about credits for degraded availability during the uplift window; recommend we limit SLA credits to existing schedule and not offer additional credits for burst capacity.

Can legal prepare a compact redline and call out the three negotiables above so I can pre-run them with Elena if needed. Also: add HubSpot record HS-982374 to the redline package and include a single-sheet for Finance (invoice cadence options).

—Marissa

Subject: RE: CloudVista — compact redline delivery (MSA + Exhibit B)

Sofia / Marissa —

Attached is the compact redline: MSA_Exhibit-B_edited_20261103.pdf. Key legal notes (TL;DR):
1) Term change: accepted. Inserted effective date 2026-12-01; added renewal option language (60-day notice).
2) Capacity stacking: added Exhibit B supplemental table and burst-tier pricing. Language clarifies that burst tokens are billed after the committed tier consumption.
3) Indemnity: retained Redwood’s existing indemnity cap but added a limited carve for customer data processing claims tied specifically to configuration errors. This is a narrow, mutual warranty carve rather than a full indemnity broadening.
4) Data retention: proposed compromise as Marissa suggested — 180 days for non-security audit logs; 365 for security/audit logs. Inserted a short definition of "audit logs" to avoid ambiguity.
5) SLA/credits: declined additional credits for burst capacity; preserved standard SLA schedule.

I copied Priya so procurement can confirm PO and invoice cadence. If Priya is comfortable, we can send this to Elena with a short summary and DocuSign envelope.

Redline attachments: MSA_Exhibit-B_edited_20261103.pdf (redline), and a companion clean Exhibit B for signature.
